2021.3.2

Description of the bug:
When opening VRChat I am unable to get to my home, or any other, world and just receive the error 'VRChat experienced an internal error'. I have followed all of the standard uninstall/reinstall and clear cache steps but this does not help. I'm not able to attach full debug logs here but the error 'Server: 'ns.exitgames.com' ErrorCode: 10040 SocketErrorCode: MessageSize Message: Message too long ' seems to be the last thing shown in the logs before 'VRChat experienced an internal error' is reported.

Steps to reproduce (how did you encounter the bug?):
Open VRChat. I've tried both the Oculus and Steam client and tried in Desktop only mode, all produce the same error, even when logging into a newly created test account.
